title: The unfinished handoff
body: The pickup card assigns each trailer a time, then records the vehicle at the gate before the first family is listed. The spare hitch key is still here.
rival_reading: The same route could have moved field workers or supplies; an early vehicle mark does not identify its purpose.
gloss: A pickup record places transport at the gate before the household list was completed.

title: Kept from the drawer
body: You said one bite was enough, so I marked the water barrel too. The field crew calls the rinse routine; I still will not let the dog drink until the tank is flushed.
rival_reading: A containment crew could have rinsed a trailer tank during cleanup; the warning does not establish what caused the danger.
gloss: A family water warning follows a field crew rinse and leaves the source uncertain.
